scenario: LCON.4.3.2 — no real-adapter traffic on un-mocked services: with no mock declared for svc.read, the call fires but no CallResponse is delivered, so the `on response` continuation never runs (no log). The negative companion to LCON.4.3.1, confirming it is the mock (not the engine) that synthesises the response — the engine never fabricates a CallResponse (LCRS.7.3).
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as "corr1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "got response"
